column1: # Divergence allowlist — stack-graphs Phase 1 shadow invalidation (spec §5, §8).
# Columns (tab-separated): category, match-kind (classifier|path-prefix), pattern, justification, disposition.
# match-kind "classifier" is an exact match on the resolved element's classifier name.
# match-kind "path-prefix" is a String#startsWith match on the element's path.
# disposition "accept" = expected to remain a divergence indefinitely.
# disposition "phase2-model" = expected to close once a later phase adds the missing model support.
# Do not add rows speculatively: categories are added only when an actual divergence is observed and
# justified (see Tasks 9-10). This file gates correctness — a malformed row fails DivergenceAllowlist.load().
